Tuesday Night Easy Ride

Pocatello, ID · Road

Tuesday Night Easy Ride is a road group ride in Pocatello, ID. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Barrie's Ski and Sports.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: leisure, adjusted to the group. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @barriesskiandsports the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Easy Ride group ride

A beginner road ride out Fort Hall Mine Road and back, about 17 miles. Someone on the ride will help with seat height, shifting, flats and posture. No-drop and paced to whoever shows up. I.C.E. membership is $10 and can be bought at the shop before the ride. The same club and shop run a Thursday night no-drop ride for all levels.
